reviews.title: It's a UHD-friendly drive.
reviews.comment:
Manufacture date: Nov. 2024
Manufacturer firmware: 1.V9
DVDFab successfully reverted the firmware to version 1.00, making it UHD-friendly.
This is an Internal drive, so if you use it in an external box, you will get a lot of vibration sound.
I highly recommend this drive to back up or play your 4K Ultra Blu-rays.

reviews.title: today i got it and im happy with it.
reviews.comment:
I'd say this purchase is pretty good, since it came with a bunch of stuff like screws, cables, and some useful support stuff, it also came with 5 free bd-rs, that is nice, i personally prefer verbatim but plexdisc is good for testing. i bought this drive for mainly archiving my stuff and for scanning discs.
the only complaint i have is mainly from amazon, and that is as to why you are shipping stuff in a thin plastic bag, this is a high precision device and its being treated like some plastic toy.
